No browser, n"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"o Electron, just your terminal."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It is **not** a model wrapper or a plain chat REPL — it drives the real agent runtime."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Live streaming** — answers render token-by-token as the model generates.
- **Reasoning display**"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" — `thinking` blocks stream dim/italic, with per-turn effort control (`/model <id> high`).

- **Session management** — list and resume any persisted session (`/resu"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"me`).
- **Permission modes** — `read-only` / `workspace-write` / `danger-full-access`, switchable li"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"ve (`/permissions`).
- **Plan mode** — toggle plan-first behavior (`/plan`).
- **Compaction** — shri"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"nk the conversation on demand (`/compact`).
- **Trajectory** — a filtered event timeline of the whol"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"e session (`/trajectory`).
- **Diagnostics** — environment + model-catalog health check (`/doctor`)."},{"id":"p7s10","text":"
- **Scrollback** — mouse wheel / `PgUp` / `PgDn`, with `↑ N` indicator.
- **Markdown rendering** — "},{"id":"p7s11","text":"fenced code blocks, inline code, bold, headings, lists.
- **Cross-platform** — macOS and Linux termi"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"nals (iTerm2, Terminal.app, kitty, alacritty, xterm, …)."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"`dsh-tui` is a DeepSeek Harness plugin. | `/model <id> [effort]` | switch live, e.g. `/model deepseek-v4-pro high` |
| `/resume` | list per"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"sisted sessions (id, title, date) |
| `/resume <n>` | continue that session with full history |
| `/"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"permissions` | list permission presets |

| `/plan` | toggle plan mode |
| `/compact` | compact the conversat"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"ion now |
| `/trajectory` | show the session event timeline |
| `/settings` | one-screen summary of "},{"id":"p19s7","text":"model/permission/plan/stream state |
| `/doctor` | environment + model catalog health check |
| `/ve"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"rsion` | dsh-tui + runtime versions |
| `/status` | session, cwd, event and turn counts |
